name: JSON:API User Resources
description: Adds JSON:API endpoints for anonymous user registration, password-reset request, and one-time-login password update.

suggests.drupal/jsonapi_hypermedia: Dev/optional. When installed, the module exposes an `authenticated-as` top-level hypermedia link pointing to the current user's JSON:API individual resource.

project_description:
Provides JSON:API resources for user account operations that core's JSON:API deliberately does not expose, built on the JSON:API Resources framework. It adds three anonymous-only endpoints for building a decoupled/headless front end: register a new account, request a password reset, and complete a password update from a one-time-login link.

Endpoints (all prefixed with the JSON:API base path, default /jsonapi; all require the caller to be NOT logged in):

- POST /jsonapi/user/register - create a new user account (honours user.settings.register and verify_mail).
- POST /jsonapi/user/password/reset - request a password-reset email by name or mail.
- PATCH /jsonapi/user/{user}/password/update - set a new password using a timestamp+hash from the reset link.

The user password may also be updated using core's /jsonapi/user/user/{user} endpoint. The module dispatches events (registration validate/complete, password reset) that subscribers use to send the standard user notification emails.
